Container.Name: chummer-anarchy2
Container.Overview: Character generator and career tracker for Shadowrun: Anarchy 2.0. A static web app: characters are kept in your browser and exported as .ca2.json files. Put overlay XML (house rules, extra gear) in the Custom data folder and list it in custom/index.xml.

Config.Name: Custom data
Config.Description: House-rule and extra-content XML overlays (list them in index.xml)
